notes: NEW subject pack: Computer Science Basics — binary and bits, algorithms, data structures, Boolean logic, Big-O complexity, networks and the internet, databases, and cybersecurity basics, with which-idea, binary-to-decimal, and loop-tracing practice, never your assignment.

Detector V27 was trained and measured this run but HELD, not shipped: on the permanent frozen probe it caught 12 of 18 humanized texts, the same as V26 and below the shipped V20’s 13, so V20 stays live until a round genuinely beats it. The second-family round lifted the second probe to 12 of 12, neural-paraphrase detection to a best-yet 55.4% (from 51.1%), and held GPT-5 detection at 92.6%, with the false-flag rate at 4.56%, still below V20’s 4.71%.
